changeSet.author: lexavault
changeSet.sql: alter table pipeline_jobs add constraint ck_pipeline_jobs_page_range check ((page_from is null and page_to is null) or (page_from is not null and page_to is not null and page_from >= 1 and page_to >= page_from)); -- A stage job (TEXT, FIND, REDACT) always names its document. alter table pipeline_jobs add constraint ck_pipeline_jobs_stage_document check (stage not in ('TEXT', 'FIND', 'REDACT') or document_id is not null); drop index if exists ux_pipeline_jobs_identity; -- One job per stage, case run, document, page range, destination and item: queuing twice adds nothing. -- For export jobs the document stays as before (EXPORT: none; SPLIT_EXPORT: its source document, which -- the item already names), so nothing changes for them. create unique index ux_pipeline_jobs_identity on pipeline_jobs ( tenant_id, stage, package_id, export_cycle, coalesce(case when stage in ('TEXT', 'FIND', 'REDACT') then document_id end, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid), coalesce(page_from, 0), coalesce(destination_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid), coalesce(item_id, '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'::uuid)); -- The recovery scans ask "does this case have stage jobs?". create index idx_pipeline_jobs_stage_package on pipeline_jobs (package_id) where stage in ('TEXT', 'FIND', 'REDACT');
